page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head above it and the page number at top right. Section numbers XIV to XVIII sit on their own lines, each followed by its paragraph. Below the last paragraph, at the right, is a catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.p: KVEFSTAINIO ET GEROLTZECKIO munitissimis arcibus expugnatis, septenæ insignes pręfecturę ditioni Austriacę partim adjectę, partim quasi postliminio quodā restitutæ.
ARNHEMIO, QUOD PRIMARIUM Geldrię oppidum est, capto Carolo, DUCE Geldrię, qui, Gallorum partes secutus, rebus in inferiori Germania novandis semper studuerat, pax supplici data.
PERCUSSO CUM IULIO XI. PONTIFICE maximo, ac Hispaniarum & Galliæ regibus fœdere, Veneti tota propemodum continenti, quam in Italia possidebant, depulsi, & ad summam rerum desperationem adacti.
INSIGNES VENETORUM URBES, Patavium, Verona, Vicentia, una cum magna fori Iulii parte in potestatem redactæ; Brixia vero auxiliaribus Gallorum armis expugnata.
SOCIETATE CUM IULIO PONTIFICE & pagis Helvetiorum contractâ, Galli penitus Italia ejecti, Maximilianusque Sforcia[?], tot jam annis exul, paterno Insubriæ principatu restitutus.

page.notes: The section numbers XIV to XVIII are set apart on their own lines but are bare numerals, so they are written as paragraphs. The page number is printed as "223", with the 3 in a worn form. The catchword at the lower right is hard to read; the reading "IVN-" is doubtful. "Sforcia" is a doubtful reading of a name that is partly blurred. The ę and æ ligatures are copied as printed. The printed hyphen at the line end in "adje-ctę" is closed up.
